in_sanskrit.name: Ismile
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Smiling IS (God)
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Ismile एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Ismile is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Ish' and 'Smile'. Ish is the name of the supreme God in Hinduism, while Smile represents happiness and contentment. This name signifies the divine presence of God in one's life, bringing joy and happiness.
